description: Italian residential household with air-source heat pump. Derived from real 15-min smart meter data (Folgaria, Trentino, Sep 2025 - Jan 2026). Consumption is strongly daytime-weighted due to heat pump operation during PV production hours.
source: Real smart meter data, c2g-686DEF19C, Folgaria (TN)
region: Trentino-Alto Adige (applicable to Alpine/Northern Italy heat pump households)
notes: Times are in standard local time (Europe/Rome, no daylight saving adjustments)
Peak consumption: 10:00-12:00 (heat pump + appliances during daytime)
76.8% of daily consumption falls during sun hours (08:00-17:00)
Compared to standard residential (PVGIS EU): daytime consumption is 2.5x higher
Derived from 5 full months of real data (Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec, Jan)
Expected self-consumption rate with this profile: 60-85% (vs 25-35% standard residential)

monthly_weights_validation.source: Same as residential_default — winter-heavy seasonal pattern
monthly_weights_validation.note: Heat pump households have even stronger winter weighting in practice, but using the same weights for consistency. Future: derive from full-year data.
